Arema

events.title: Obolon'-Brovar vs Karpaty
events.dataContent:
Obolon' (Kyiv) vs. Karpaty (Lviv): UPL Live Stream

On Monday evening, September 22, 2025, at 15:00 UTC (18:00 MSK), a sixth-round match of the 2025/26 Ukrainian Premier League season will take place between two teams from the lower half of the table. At the Obolon-Arena in Kyiv, local side Obolon' will host the newly-promoted Karpaty Lviv. Tutsport.net will provide a live video broadcast of this encounter.

Pre-Match Analysis

Obolon' (Kyiv)

Obolon' is having a disastrous start to the new season. After five rounds, the team is in the penultimate, 15th place in the league table with only 2 points. The "Brewers" are yet to secure a single victory in the championship and come into the match with a six-game winless streak. In their last outing, Obolon' lost the derby to Dynamo. The team is experiencing serious problems in attack. The home game against a direct competitor is the best opportunity to secure their first win of the season.

Karpaty (Lviv)

Karpaty, who have returned to the UPL after a long absence, has had a slightly better start to the championship. The "Lions" are in 12th place with 4 points. In their last match, the team secured their first victory of the season, defeating Kolos. This result should boost the team's confidence. In the match against an underdog, Karpaty will be looking to build on their success and earn important points.

Head-to-Head History

The history of encounters between these two teams is quite balanced. Most of their meetings took place several years ago in the First League. In the last five head-to-head meetings, Karpaty has a slight edge with two wins to Obolon's one, with the other two matches ending in a draw. The last meeting between the teams ended in a victory for Karpaty.

Obolon' vs. Karpaty Match Prediction

A very tense and even match is expected between two teams in desperate need of points. Obolon' will have the home-field advantage. Karpaty, on the other hand, is on an emotional high after their first victory. Given the attacking struggles of both teams, a high-scoring affair is not expected.
Our prediction: Total goals under 2.5.

events.title: Borneo vs Persis Solo
events.dataContent:
Borneo vs. Persis Solo: Indonesian Liga 1 Live Stream

Borneo has had a magnificent start to the new season. The team leads the league table, having not suffered a single defeat. In their last outing, Borneo secured an away victory over Persita. In a home match, the league leaders will be aiming for nothing less than a victory to solidify their position.

In their last match, the team lost 2-1 at home to Bali United. The trip to face the league leaders will be a major test for Persis Solo.

Borneo vs. Persis Solo Match Prediction

Despite the balanced head-to-head history, Borneo is the clear favorite in this match. The team is in excellent form, is playing at home, and has shown more consistent football. Persis Solo, on the other hand, is still trying to find its game.

events.title: Dynamo Kyiv vs Oleksandria
events.dataContent:
Dynamo Kyiv vs. Oleksandriya: UPL Live Stream

On Monday afternoon, September 22, 2025, at 12:30 UTC (15:30 MSK), a sixth-round match of the 2025/26 Ukrainian Premier League season will take place at the Valeriy Lobanovskyi Dynamo Stadium. Dynamo Kyiv will host FC Oleksandriya. Tutsport.net will provide a live video broadcast of this encounter.

Pre-Match Analysis

Dynamo Kyiv

Dynamo, one of the main contenders for the championship title, has had a strong start to the championship. The team is in fourth place in the table, having not suffered a single defeat. The "White-Blues" have secured three wins and two draws, showing good productivity. In their last outing, Dynamo won the derby against Obolon 3-1. In a home match against an underdog, the Kyiv side will be aiming for nothing less than a victory to continue their fight for the top spot.

Oleksandriya

Oleksandriya is having a disastrous start to the new season. The team is in the lower part of the league table, in 14th place with 3 points. Oleksandriya is yet to secure a single victory, with two losses and three draws. In their last match, the team lost to Polissya. The trip to Kyiv to face one of the league leaders, against whom Oleksandriya has historically struggled, will be a major test for them.

Head-to-Head History

The history of encounters between these two teams shows total dominance by Dynamo. The Kyiv club is unbeaten in their last 18 matches against Oleksandriya, winning 16 of them. The last meeting between the teams last season ended in a 1-0 victory for Dynamo.

Dynamo Kyiv vs. Oleksandriya Match Prediction

This match has a clear and undisputed favorite. The excellent form of Dynamo, their powerful performances at home, and the dire situation of Oleksandriya leave the visitors with virtually no chance. The dominant head-to-head record only confirms the difference in class between the two teams.
Our prediction: Dynamo to win with a (-1.5) handicap.

events.dataContent:

On Monday evening, September 22, 2025, at 16:00 UTC (19:00 MSK), a 9th-round match of the Russian Premier League will take place at the Fisht Stadium in Sochi. Local club FC Sochi will host one of the league leaders, CSKA Moscow. Tutsport.net will provide a live video broadcast of this encounter.

Sochi

Sochi is having a disastrous start to the season. The team is at the bottom of the league table, in 16th place with 4 points. The "Leopards" are winless in their last seven matches, suffering six defeats in that period. The team has the worst defense in the league, having conceded 19 goals in eight games. In their last outing, the Sochi side lost away to Krylia Sovetov. The match against one of the league leaders, to whom Sochi lost just recently in the Cup, will be a major test for the hosts.

CSKA (Moscow)

The "Army Men" are in third place, having not suffered a single defeat in the RPL this season. They have five wins and three draws to their name. In their last match, CSKA defeated Rostov away from home. The "Red-Blues" will be looking to extend their unbeaten streak and continue their pursuit of the top spot.

The history of encounters between these two teams in recent years has favored CSKA. The "Army Men" have won four of the last six head-to-head meetings. The most recent match between the teams was just a few days ago, on September 18, in the Russian Cup, where CSKA secured a convincing victory.

Sochi vs. CSKA Match Prediction

This match has a clear and undisputed favorite. The excellent form of CSKA and the dire situation of Sochi leave the hosts with virtually no chance. The dominant head-to-head record only confirms the difference in class between the two teams.

events.title: Olympique Marseille vs PSG
events.dataContent:
Marseille vs. PSG: Ligue 1 Match Live Stream

On Monday, September 22, 2025, at 18:00 UTC (21:00 MSK), the central match of the 5th round of the French Ligue 1 will take place, featuring the two most decorated and irreconcilable rivals in the country - Marseille will host Paris Saint-Germain. This confrontation, known as "Le Classique," always attracts huge attention from fans worldwide. Tutsport.net will provide a live video broadcast and text commentary of this encounter.

Pre-Match Analysis

Marseille

Olympique de Marseille approaches the main French derby with a desire to prove their championship ambitions. The team traditionally performs strongly at their home stadium, the "Stade Vélodrome," where the support of the fans is one of the key factors for success. Marseille will aim to challenge PSG and use their attacking opportunities to please the home crowd.

PSG

Paris Saint-Germain, the hegemon of French football in recent years, comes into the match as the favorite. Despite the possible absence of some key players, the Parisian squad is full of world-class stars capable of deciding the outcome of the match on their own. For PSG, winning "Le Classique" is not just about three points, but a matter of prestige.

Head-to-Head History

The history of confrontations favors the Parisian club. In recent meetings, PSG has more often been victorious. However, matches between Marseille and PSG at the "Vélodrome" are always tense and unpredictable, and statistics do not always play a decisive role. Overall, PSG has the advantage in the number of head-to-head wins.

Marseille vs. PSG Match Prediction

Despite their away status, Paris Saint-Germain looks stronger due to a more powerful and balanced squad. However, Marseille is capable of putting up a fight against any opponent on their home turf, and the support of the stands could be a significant advantage for them. A tense match with a lot of struggle is expected.
Our prediction: PSG to win with a narrow margin.

events.title: Napoli vs Pisa
events.dataContent:
Napoli vs. Pisa: Serie A Match Live Stream

On Monday, September 22, 2025, at 18:45 UTC (21:45 MSK), reigning Italian champions Napoli will host Serie A newcomers Pisa at their home ground, the Diego Armando Maradona Stadium. This match will conclude the 4th round of the championship. For the Neapolitans, it is an opportunity to strengthen their position at the top of the table, while for the visitors, it is a chance to try and pick up points against a formidable opponent. Tutsport.net will provide a live video broadcast and text commentary of this encounter.

Pre-Match Analysis

Napoli

Napoli, under the management of Antonio Conte, have started their title defense strongly with victories in the opening rounds of the championship. The team is in excellent form in Serie A, boasting one of the longest unbeaten streaks in Europe's top five leagues. However, a recent defeat in the Champions League to Manchester City could affect the team's morale, and they will be eager to bounce back in front of their home fans. A key player for the Neapolitans is Kevin De Bruyne, who has already made a significant impact with goals and assists in the new season.

Pisa

Pisa has returned to the top flight of Italian football and is currently facing difficulties adapting. The team, managed by Alberto Gilardino, has only managed to secure one point in the opening rounds. Pisa's main problem lies in their attack, having scored only one goal so far, which was an own goal by an opponent. The match against the champions away from home will be a serious test for the Serie A newcomers.

Head-to-Head History

The history of encounters is entirely in Napoli's favor. In 14 top-flight meetings, Pisa has never managed to defeat the Neapolitans (4 draws and 10 losses). The last time the teams met in an official match was in 2007 in the Coppa Italia, where Napoli secured a convincing 3-1 victory. Overall, Napoli is undefeated in their last 6 matches against Pisa across all competitions.

Napoli vs. Pisa Match Prediction

Considering the current form of the teams, their squads, and the head-to-head history, Napoli are the clear favorites for this match. Playing at home, the Neapolitans will be aiming for a convincing win to please their fans after the European setback. Pisa will likely focus on defense, but containing the hosts' potent attacking line will be extremely difficult.
Our prediction: Napoli to win with a (-1.5) handicap.

Join our broadcast to follow the events of the match at the Diego Armando Maradona Stadium!

events.title: Ballon d`Or 2025
events.dataContent:
Ballon d'Or 2025: Live Stream of the Ceremony

On Monday, September 22, 2025, at 19:00 UTC (22:00 MSK), the famous Théâtre du Châtelet in Paris will host the 69th annual Ballon d'Or ceremony, the most prestigious individual award in world football. The entire football world is holding its breath in anticipation of the announcement of the best player of the 2024/25 season. Tutsport.net will provide a live video broadcast and text commentary of this grand event.

Main Contenders for the Award

This year's race for the Ballon d'Or promises to be particularly intriguing. Several players who have shown outstanding results throughout the season stand out as the main favorites.

Ousmane Dembélé (PSG)

The French forward from Paris Saint-Germain is considered the main contender for the award. Having had a phenomenal season, Dembélé helped his club win the Champions League, Ligue 1, and the Coupe de France. He became the top scorer and best player in the French league and was also named the best player of the Champions League. Over the season, he scored 35 goals and provided 16 assists.

Lamine Yamal (Barcelona)

Barcelona's young prodigy is Dembélé's main competitor. At just 18 years old, Yamal has become a key player for the Catalan club, leading them to victory in La Liga and the Copa del Rey. His incredible technique and mature play allowed him to score 18 goals and make 21 assists during the season.

Other Candidates

Other notable contenders for the award include Real Madrid's star forward Kylian Mbappé, Liverpool's leader Mohamed Salah, and PSG's Portuguese midfielder Vitinha.

New Awards and Format

This year, the ceremony, co-organized by France Football and UEFA, will feature several new awards, including for women's football. Prizes will be awarded to the best male and female players, best young players, goalkeepers, coaches, and clubs of the year.

Prediction for the Ceremony's Outcome

Despite Lamine Yamal's incredible talent, Ousmane Dembélé's outstanding season and his key role in PSG's treble-winning campaign make him the main favorite to receive the Ballon d'Or. His success at the club level, supported by individual awards, should be the deciding factor for the jury.
Our prediction: Ousmane Dembélé will win the 2025 Ballon d'Or.

Join our broadcast to be the first to know the name of the best footballer on the planet!

events.title: Sporting CP vs Moreirense
events.dataContent:
Sporting CP vs. Moreirense: Primeira Liga Match Live Stream

On Monday, September 22, 2025, at 19:15 UTC (22:15 MSK), the Estádio José Alvalade in Lisbon will host a 6th round match of the Portuguese Primeira Liga, where reigning champions Sporting CP will take on one of the surprise packages of the season's start, Moreirense. Both teams come into this head-to-head encounter with identical records, adding intrigue to this clash. Tutsport.net will provide a live video broadcast and text commentary of this encounter.

Pre-Match Analysis

Sporting CP

Sporting Lisbon has started the new season strongly, intending to defend their championship title. Rúben Amorim's team has secured four wins in the first five league rounds and had a successful start in the Champions League, confidently defeating Kairat 4-1. The "Lions" are showing high productivity, having scored 15 goals in five league matches. However, the team faces some injury problems: Daniel Bragança and Nuno Santos are injured, and the participation of several other key players is also in doubt.

Moreirense

Moreirense has been a real surprise at the start of the championship, also claiming four victories in five games. The team has demonstrated a solid defense, conceding only four goals. The "Green and Whites" are heading to Lisbon in high spirits after a 3-1 victory over Rio Ave. However, it should be noted that Moreirense has not yet faced any of the top teams in Portuguese football. The upcoming match will be their main test of strength.

Head-to-Head History

The history of encounters is entirely in Sporting's favor. In the last six head-to-head meetings, the Lisbon club has won five, while Moreirense has won one. In these matches, Sporting scored 12 goals, while Moreirense managed only 3. The last meeting between the teams in April 2025 ended with a 3-1 victory for Sporting.

Sporting CP vs. Moreirense Match Prediction

Despite Moreirense's impressive start, Sporting is the undisputed favorite for the match. The class of players, experience, and home-field advantage should be decisive factors. The "Lions" will be keen to keep pace with league leaders Porto and are unlikely to slip up. The visitors will probably focus on organized defense and counter-attacks, but containing the hosts' powerful offense will be extremely difficult for them.
Our prediction: Sporting to win and total goals over 2.5.
